title: Transcendence of Tonelli--Shanks Power Modulo Infinitely Large Primes
summary: For a prime number $p$, we denote by $k_p$ the greatest odd divisor of $p-1$. Tonelli--Shanks algorithm is a classical algorithm to compute a square root of a quadratic residue $n \in \mathbb{Z}$ modulo $p$ as the product of $n^{\frac{k_p+1}{2}}$, which we call {\it Tonelli--Shanks power of $n$}, and a correction term given as a power of a quadratic non-residue modulo $p$.
